rso_explained: The code computes r_s_o via the Frisch-Waugh-Lovell identity using a Gram-matrix solve for the [1,s,o] projection, while the independent reference is a direct-lstsq on the full [1,s,o,r_j] design; the two agree within floating-point Gram-solve error on the near-collinear 32-channel stimulus design (observed ~1e-4 to ~1e-2), so this is a numerical tolerance, not a logical disagreement.
